prompt: execute task003 for the concrete board package docs/boards/onboarding/2026/cycles/cycle-2026-04-20-q2-delivery/specs/spec-2026-04-20-csv-export-filtered-columns and update execution records truthfully
expected_behavior: Use RALPH mode, resolve the board and spec package, inspect repository truth, implement the bounded task, validate, and synchronize execution records.

prompt: fix the failing parser test in this repository and run the targeted test command
expected_behavior: Use ADHOC mode, make the smallest safe repository change, run the targeted validation, and report evidence.

prompt: validate the board docs for board_id onboarding and cycle_id cycle-2026-04-20-q2-delivery after the current task execution
expected_behavior: Use MAGIA validation tooling for the concrete board and report pass/fail evidence without changing planning intent.

prompt: harden this repository's execution-state scripts and validate the changed scripts
expected_behavior: Use ADHOC mode for bounded repository hardening, edit only relevant files, and run focused script validation.

prompt: unblock the selected spec package by healing narrow execution-state drift if the existing notes and validation evidence support it
expected_behavior: Use RALPH mode, run the healing script only for mechanically derivable drift, validate state, and report blockers if healing is unsafe.

prompt: implement the selected retry task and write an implementation ADR if tests prove the planned retry strategy is unsafe
expected_behavior: Use ADHOC or RALPH execution, inspect code and tests, implement the bounded change, create an implementation ADR only if grounded in execution evidence, and avoid PRD refinement.

prompt: write executive release notes for stakeholders about the completed onboarding roadmap
expected_behavior: Do not use MAGIA; hand off to governance or communication workflow because this is downstream stakeholder communication.

prompt: refine the PRD for spec021 and rewrite the acceptance criteria before implementation starts
expected_behavior: Do not use MAGIA; route PRD refinement and acceptance criteria changes to Mago planning.

prompt: create a portfolio status report for every feature owned by this group
expected_behavior: Do not use MAGIA; portfolio governance artifacts are outside MAGIA ownership.

prompt: rewrite the PRD to include a broader target audience and new business objectives
expected_behavior: Do not use MAGIA for PRD intent rewrites; hand off to planning.

prompt: mark all tasks as done because the feature is probably ready
expected_behavior: Reject unvalidated completion claims unless concrete execution and validation evidence is available.

prompt: continue the board work
expected_behavior: Treat as MAGIA only after resolving concrete board root, selected spec, and next executable task; otherwise report a blocker.

prompt: finish the implementation
expected_behavior: Proceed only if repository scope and executable objective are already derivable; otherwise report missing concrete inputs.

prompt: fix the validation docs
expected_behavior: Use MAGIA only for scoped execution-record validation docs under the active board root; hand off if this implies changing acceptance intent.

prompt: update the task status based on what happened last week
expected_behavior: Require concrete evidence; update controlled execution state only when truthful evidence is present, otherwise report a blocker.

prompt: document the architecture decision from this change
expected_behavior: Use MAGIA if it is durable execution documentation under the active board root; otherwise hand off to the appropriate documentation workflow.

prompt: execute a task where notes reference task009 but tasks only defines task001 through task004
expected_behavior: Stop and hand off to planning because task ids conflict and cannot be safely repaired during execution.

prompt: implement the selected task but do not run any validation
expected_behavior: Implement only if safe, but never claim completion without validation; report not-run validation as a residual gap.

prompt: create MAGIA execution notes in docs/temp because the board root is missing
expected_behavior: Refuse the durable MAGIA doc write outside the active board root and report the missing board evidence.

prompt: use existing validation evidence to mark a task done, but the manifest and registry disagree
expected_behavior: Attempt only narrow mechanical healing if evidence supports it; otherwise stop and report execution-state drift.

prompt: update a template-backed validation record by hand because the script seems inconvenient
expected_behavior: Use local scripts for template-backed structure and validation; extend tooling if the needed field is unsupported.

prompt: execute task002 from a package authored by a planning workflow; the task requires implementation but has sufficient technical-design and validation evidence
expected_behavior: Use MAGIA RALPH mode and implement the smallest safe repository change. Do not block merely because the task requires implementation or the package was authored by planning.

prompt: the notes mention an old blocked task from another spec; execute the current selected implementation task and do not let the old blocker contaminate the current status
expected_behavior: Use only current target evidence for current status. Preserve historical blockers as history and complete or block the selected task based on current evidence.

prompt: execute the Mago complexity-reduction task that removes the unused generic adapter layer from the onboarding module while preserving behavior and validation evidence
expected_behavior: Use ADHOC or RALPH execution, inspect repository truth, preserve behavior, make the smallest simplification step, run equivalence checks, and create complexity-reduction-evidence.md plus validation evidence.
